note: Loops (owner, 11 Nov): the 15 starter badges of docs/world-designer/words.md and the follower milestones. status: wired (the game gives it) or coming (the feature it needs does not exist yet: why says what is missing). card_made is the older id of Card Carried, kept so saves and cards keep their badge. src/loops.js gives them; src/cards.js shows the names.
